correctness.rationale: Exact McGee LCF representation 24-cycle plus cyclic chords (12,7,−7)×8 gives a 24-vertex, 36-edge cubic graph with girth seven. Independent fresh full face enumeration produced 34304 nonempty independent faces, with size vector (1,24,240,1304,4212,8328,10024,7072,2668,424,8) including the empty face. Reconstructed the prescribed deterministic 24-stage toggle matching on the entire face poset: 17151 matched ordinary cover pairs, leaving precisely singleton {0} as the only critical 0-cell and set {2,5,12,14,17,21} as the only critical 5-cell. Independently oriented and topologically sorted all 197768 cover relations, processing every one of 34304 nonempty faces; acyclicity is exhaustive. Forman implies a CW model with only 0 and 5-cell; attaching map S4→point is null, giving S5 integral homotopy. The mod-two homology cross-check is not used to infer integrality or homotopy.

value.rationale: The McGee graph is the unique minimal cubic graph of girth 7, an unusually canonical finite extremal graph, so its independence complex is a natural exact invariant rather than an arbitrary induced subgraph. A dimension-9 complex collapsing integrally to just S5 is a strong and reusable homotopy classification; vertex data, independence polynomial, graph girth, and mod-2 Betti ranks would not imply it. Complete exact reduction is a motivated finite theorem even without extending to every cubic cage.

limitations: Only the specific McGee graph, no all-(3,g)-cage formula.
Unindexed finite complexes and uninspected full graph-family references may contain equivalent results.
